;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A senior [[Taliban]] commander, Mullah Abdul Manan Akhund, is killed in a [[United States|U.S.]] air strike in [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46418776 (BBC)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**At least 19 people [[Nduga massacre|are killed]] as armed group linked to [[West Papua Liberation Organization]] attacks construction workers at [[Trans Papua]] road project in [[Nduga Regency]], [[Papua (province)|Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/377548/west-papua-liberation-army-claims-responsibility-for-papua-killings (Radio NZ)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Eight people are presumed killed after an [[Embraer EMB-720]] crashes in the [[Amazon Rainforest]], [[Brazil]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/218989 (Aviation Safety Network)] 
*Seven people are killed and seven others injured after a landslide an Inn in [[North Sumatra Province]], [[Indonesia]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-12/02/c_137646056.htm (Xinhua)]

;Politics and elections
*[[COP24]] 
**The [[COP24|24th Conference of the Parties]] to the [[United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change]] convenes in [[Katowice]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-46398057 (BBC News)]
**At least 65,000 people gather in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]], in a march for more action on protecting the climate. [http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20181202_04004015 (''De Standaard'')] 
*[[Elections in Spain]], [[2018 Andalusian regional election]]
**The [[Spanish Socialist Workers' Party of Andalusia|Socialist]] and current regional President [[Susana Díaz]] wins the election, but loses 14 seats. [https://www.elmundo.es/andalucia/2018/12/02/5c043423fdddff8b148b45df.html (''El Mundo'')]
**The far-right and anti-immigration [[Vox (Spanish political party)|Vox]] enters a legislative chamber after winning 12 seats, for the first time in the [[History of Spain (1975–present)|history of Spanish democracy]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/03/europe/spain-far-right-vox-andalucia-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/02/world/europe/spain-andalusia-election.html (''The New York Times'')]
